title: ALLNOBLANKROW returns a BLANK that is stored in the column

source.quote: If the table contains blank values in columns, these values are included in the result
source.supports: blank values stored in the column are returned

source.quote: The only blank row that is ignored is the one added to a table in case of an invalid relationship
source.supports: only the blank row of the invalid relationship is ignored

derivation: Product[Color] stores Red, Blue and a BLANK (Bell): 3 values. Only the blank row added for the orphan Sales rows is left out.
